intro: Free full texts of the early Church Fathers and great saints. Links open on other sites.

groups.title: Linked to the Apostles
groups.note: Writers traditionally linked to the apostles or their disciples.

items.title: 1 Clement
items.author: Clement of Rome
items.line: Letter to the church at Corinth, c. 96. Clement is traditionally said to have known Peter and Paul. New Advent: tr. John Keith (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 9).

items.title: Seven Letters
items.author: Ignatius of Antioch
items.line: Letters, c. 107–110, traditionally said to have been written on his way to martyrdom in Rome. New Advent: tr. Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: Letter to the Philippians
items.author: Polycarp of Smyrna
items.line: Letter, c. 110–140. According to Irenaeus, Polycarp was a disciple of St. John. New Advent: tr. Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: The Martyrdom of Polycarp
items.author: The Church of Smyrna
items.line: Letter of the church of Smyrna describing his death, c. 155. New Advent: tr. Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: Fragments
items.author: Papias of Hierapolis
items.line: Fragments, c. 115–140, of a collection of oral traditions about the apostles. New Advent: tr. Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: Fragment of his Apology
items.author: Quadratus of Athens
items.line: Fragment of an apology, c. 124–125, surviving in Eusebius, Church History IV.3 (chapter 3 on the New Advent page). New Advent: tr. Arthur Cushman McGiffert (Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, second series, vol. 1).

items.title: The Didache
items.author: Anonymous
items.line: Early church manual, late 1st century. New Advent: tr. M.B. Riddle (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 7).

items.title: Letter to Diognetus
items.author: Anonymous
items.line: Anonymous letter, 2nd century. New Advent: tr. Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: First Apology
items.author: St. Justin Martyr
items.line: Apology addressed to Emperor Antoninus Pius, c. 155. New Advent: tr. Marcus Dods and George Reith (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: Against Heresies
items.author: St. Irenaeus
items.line: Treatise in five books, c. 180. New Advent: tr. Alexander Roberts and William Rambaut (Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 1).

items.title: Confessions
items.author: St. Augustine
items.line: Autobiography in thirteen books, c. 397–400. New Advent: tr. J.G. Pilkington (Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, first series, vol. 1).

items.title: Summa Theologiae
items.author: St. Thomas Aquinas
items.line: Theological work in three parts, 1265–74. New Advent: second and revised edition, 1920, tr. Fathers of the English Dominican Province.

items.title: The Dialogue
items.author: St. Catherine of Siena
items.line: Written 1377–78. Tr. Algar Thorold, 1907 (CCEL).

items.title: Life
items.author: St. Teresa of Ávila
items.line: Autobiography, 1565. Tr. David Lewis (Project Gutenberg).

links.label: Read at Project Gutenberg
links.expect: The Life of St. Teresa of Jesus

items.title: Interior Castle
items.author: St. Teresa of Ávila
items.line: Written 1577. Tr. Benedictines of Stanbrook, 1921 (CCEL).

items.title: Ascent of Mount Carmel
items.author: St. John of the Cross
items.line: Treatise, c. 1580s (CCEL edition).

items.title: Dark Night of the Soul
items.author: St. John of the Cross
items.line: Treatise, c. 1580s (CCEL edition).

items.title: Introduction to the Devout Life
items.author: St. Francis de Sales
items.line: Book of spiritual instruction, 1609 (CCEL edition).

items.title: Story of a Soul
items.author: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
items.line: Autobiography, written 1895–97. Tr. T.N. Taylor, 1912 (Project Gutenberg).

items.title: The Imitation of Christ
items.author: Thomas à Kempis
items.line: Devotional work in four books, c. 1418–27, traditionally attributed to Thomas à Kempis. Tr. William Benham (Project Gutenberg).
